name: flin-gmp-mcp
description: Read Google Marketing Platform organizations, DV360 campaigns, CM360 reports and SA360 performance.
long_description: Connect Google Marketing Platform, Display & Video 360, Campaign Manager 360 and Search Ads 360 to Claude Desktop. Requires your own Google Desktop OAuth client and product access. Run authenticate for browser sign-in. Credentials stay on your computer. Google scopes may allow writes; this server only exposes read operations. GA4 reporting is provided by flin-ga4-mcp.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Desktop app OAuth client ID from your Google Cloud project.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same Desktop app OAuth client.

services.title: Enabled products
services.description: Comma-separated selection of admin,dv360,cm360,sa360. Enable the corresponding Google APIs.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check local configuration and token status. No Google request or browser launch.

tools.name: authenticate
tools.description: Sign in via the local browser and store credentials privately; never returns tokens.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List accessible GMP organizations (one page, max 1000); not Google Cloud organizations.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get a GMP organization by ID or organizations/{id} from list_organizations.

tools.name: list_analytics_account_links
tools.description: List Analytics accounts linked to a GMP organization; no GA4 performance data.

tools.name: list_dv360_partners
tools.description: Discover DV360 partners (max 200 per page). Optional native DV360 filter.

tools.name: list_dv360_advertisers
tools.description: List advertisers for a discovered partner ID (required by DV360 v4; max 200).

tools.name: get_dv360_advertiser
tools.description: Read one DV360 advertiser's settings.

tools.name: list_dv360_campaigns
tools.description: List DV360 campaigns settings (max 200). These are not performance metrics.

tools.name: list_dv360_insertion_orders
tools.description: List DV360 insertion orders settings (max 200). These are not performance metrics.

tools.name: list_dv360_line_items
tools.description: List DV360 line items settings (max 200). These are not performance metrics.

tools.name: list_dv360_creatives
tools.description: List DV360 creatives settings (max 200). These are not performance metrics.

tools.name: list_dv360_report_queries
tools.description: List existing DV360 report definitions via Bid Manager v2 (max 100). No report creation.

tools.name: list_dv360_reports
tools.description: List existing runs of a DV360 report query, including available report metadata/URLs.

tools.name: get_dv360_report
tools.description: Get an existing DV360 report's status and metadata, including its URL when available.

tools.name: list_cm360_profiles
tools.description: Discover accessible CM360 user profiles. Choose profileId for subsequent CM360 tools.

tools.name: list_cm360_advertisers
tools.description: List CM360 advertisers for a user profile; optional native name/ID search with * wildcards.

tools.name: list_cm360_campaigns
tools.description: List CM360 campaigns. Omit archived for both active and archived campaigns.

tools.name: list_cm360_reports
tools.description: List saved CM360 report definitions visible to this profile. Does not execute reports.

tools.name: list_cm360_report_files
tools.description: List existing CM360 report files and their status; no new report is generated.

tools.name: get_cm360_report_file
tools.description: Get existing CM360 report file metadata and download URLs; does not download CSV content.

tools.name: list_sa360_customers
tools.description: List directly accessible SA360 customer resource names. Use get_sa360_customer_clients

tools.name: query_sa360
tools.description: Run a read-only Search Ads 360 SELECT query and return one page (max 10000).

tools.name: get_sa360_customer_clients
tools.description: Discover client accounts beneath an SA360 manager, including hierarchy levels.

tools.name: get_sa360_campaign_performance
tools.description: Campaign impressions, clicks, cost_micros, conversions and conversion value.

tools.name: search_sa360_fields
tools.description: Discover SA360 query fields and compatibility using a metadata SELECT without FROM.

tools.name: list_sa360_custom_columns
tools.description: List custom columns available to an SA360 customer.
